title: JS bundle growth driven by transitive date-locale package
what: Total bundle growth (kB), date-locale-pack contribution (kB), or its share of net growth (%)

reader_questions.question: How much did the bundle grow overall, and which single package drove most of it?
reader_questions.expected: Net bundle grew +240.4 kB (482.0 to 722.4 kB), driven by date-locale-pack (+214.2 kB, 89% of net growth).

reader_questions.question: Are these measured exact build sizes or estimates?
reader_questions.expected: Exact deterministic byte counts from the bundler metafiles.

reader_questions.question: Did any module shrink in the same release?
reader_questions.expected: Yes, src/legacy/polyfill-grid.ts shrank by 11.4 kB, partially offsetting small feature additions.
